patterns.note: Content is presented in a dark mode theme with elevated, lighter dark grey cards arranged in a loose grid pattern, often with illustrative visuals paired with descriptive text within each card.
A clean, modern sans-serif typeface is used throughout, with headlines in a heavier weight for emphasis and body text maintaining good readability against the dark background.

Predominantly a very dark background (#111111 or similar) for the page, with slightly lighter dark grey for content cards. Accent colors like subtle blues, oranges, and reds are used sparingly to highlight interactive elements, code syntax, or data points.
Placeholder play buttons and progress indicators within embedded video or animation previews suggest interactive content and visual explanations of agent activity.

The page is structured with a prominent hero section, followed by a series of feature showcase sections using illustrative cards, detailed UI/UX examples, and concluding with a pricing comparison table.

technique_notes: To achieve the dark mode aesthetic, use a deep charcoal or black as the primary background. For content cards, apply a slightly lighter shade of dark grey with rounded corners and a subtle box-shadow to create an elevated, 'floating' effect.

Implement a visual hierarchy within cards by pairing bold, concise headings with supporting body text. Use distinct background colors or borders for code snippets or data visualizations to clearly separate them from surrounding content.

For interactive elements or data displays, use accent colors. For instance, code syntax highlighting can be achieved by assigning specific, contrasting colors to different code elements (strings, keywords, numbers) on a slightly darker panel.
